steps.note: J J J J (8x backwards) on the five minute Retina talk held a frame more than 3 behind the playhead at 8, 9 and 12 of 24 looks, up to 13 frames, while J J J (4x) kept up at every one (2026-10-08). Reading and converting every frame at 8x was twice what 4x does, for a clock that shows one frame in eight; it now keeps every third, holding no more than 4x. On the way, J J J from a stop at the end stopped dead on the third J: a speed change woke the old clock, which read the end.
the five minute talk at full-screen Retina size, 2880 by 1800, opened in the ordinary editor at Next defaults
End, then J J J played it backwards at four times, a fourth J at eight times, by the keys a Premiere editor uses, and the window answered inside 50ms all the while; K stopped it
THE TEST: from the end at four times backwards, 24 looks in two seconds, the picture kept up with the playhead
THE SECOND TEST: from the end at eight times backwards, 24 looks in two seconds, the picture kept up too
